metadata.style: Sketchy-medical-style scene-based mnemonics. Per-symbol logical link via phonetic, shape, acronym, or concept. Pharmacological subfamilies share visual base; functional opposites use contrasting visuals.
design_rules: PRIMARY HOOK first: the symbol must immediately evoke the RECEPTOR/DRUG name or number.
FUNCTION encoded second: how the symbol behaves matches the pharmacology.
Same concept = same recurring scene/object across all images.
DRUGS use GENERIC NAMES only — never brand names. Each drug has its own constant symbol that travels between scenes.
IONS get their own consistent symbol that appears in every channel they participate in.
Subfamilies sharing pharmacology share visual base; opposing-function subfamilies contrast visually.
user_feedback_log: 2026-05-10: animal-only theme rejected — needs per-symbol logic.
2026-05-11: subfamilies must encode functional difference (Gs vs Gi).
2026-05-11: PRIMARY HOOK to receptor itself comes before function. Memorable cultural references (Professor X for 5-HT6) work great.
2026-05-11: drugs need their own constant symbols across scenes (Flumazenil = FLU character).
2026-05-11: GENERIC names only — no brand names ever. Lithium ≠ bipolar scene (Lithium itself = Li-ion battery).

DOPA_MINE.scene_name: DOPA-MINE Co. — coal mine extracting dopamine ore
DOPA_MINE.setting: A working coal mine. Sign at entrance: 'DOPA-MINE Co.'. Inside: 4 sections labeled by pathway — Mesolimbic (heart-shaped chamber), Mesocortical (think-bubble chamber), Nigrostriatal (motor gear chamber), Tuberoinfundibular (milk-pump chamber).
recurring_elements: Vertical elevators going UP = D1-family receptors (Gs/excitatory)
Red barriers/locks blocking flow = D2-family receptors (Gi/inhibitory)
Coal carts = vesicular dopamine release
Newspaper PYRAMID hats labeled 'EXTRA' near nigrostriatal section = EPS
Milk pump at tuberoinfundibular section = prolactin

BUS_LINE_1A.setting: Old wooden bus-stop booth. Big sign: '1A'. A frantic rabbit sits trembling on the bench (= anxiety patient awaiting anxiolysis).
recurring_elements: Different buses arriving = different 1A partial agonists (Buspirone bus, Vilazodone bus, etc.)
Late bus = autoreceptor delay-of-onset for SSRIs (4-6 weeks)

TAROT_2A.setting: Dim Victorian parlor. Round table with TWO Ace tarot cards. Tie-dye hippie reader. Walls swirl with psychedelic colors. Adjacent rooms: KITCHEN (5-HT2C), WATER-GATE ROOM (5-HT3), LIBRARY (5-HT6).
recurring_elements: Hippie reader (tie-dye shirt) = LSD/Psilocybin agonist
Officer with flashlight = atypical antipsychotic (turns off the trip)
Officer with mirror = Pimavanserin (inverse agonist, flips cards face-down)

CONVENIENCE_STORE_7.setting: Glowing neon-sign 7-Eleven at midnight. Clock shows 7 AM/PM. Night-clerk on duty.
recurring_elements: Night-clerk turning off neon = Lurasidone blocking 5-HT7

ALPHA_WOLF_PACK.scene_name: Alpha wolf pack in a snowy forest
ALPHA_WOLF_PACK.setting: Snowy pine forest. A wolf pack on the hunt. Some lone alphas charge forward, others stay behind on radio. Each wolf wears a numbered tag.
recurring_elements: Lone alpha wolf (#1) = α1 receptor — true alpha hunts, post-synaptic action
Two wolves (one '#2' tag) = α2 receptor — #2 wolf pretends but is actually autoreceptor, calling pack back
Tranquilizer dart from a hunter = α1 blockade (Prazosin, antipsychotic α1 side effect)

BEETHOVEN_ORCHESTRA.setting: Concert hall. Beethoven (white wig, intense face) conducts. Different batons numbered for each symphony. Orchestra has heart-drums section (β1) and wind/brass section (β2).
recurring_elements: Beethoven with '#1' baton + heart-drums section = β1 (heart)
Beethoven with '#2' baton + winds/brass = β2 (lungs)
A fishing NET hangs by the stage door = NET transporter; Beethoven catches stray notes (NE) and returns them

AA_HOTEL.setting: Old hotel called 'Aa Hotel'. 5 floors. Each floor offers a different experience based on the α-subunit composition.
recurring_elements: Floor 1 (α1): Sleep Lobby — giant bed in the entrance
Floor 2 (α2): Calm Lounge — armchairs and tea
Floor 3 (α3): Group-therapy Room — circle of chairs
Floor 5 (α5): Memory Penthouse — secure vault
Hotel Manager = GABA itself (holds master key)
Green CHLORINE SOLDIERS rushing INTO neurons = Cl⁻ influx → hyperpolarization → inhibition
Barbed-wire fence around hotel = Phenobarbital
Bayit-B small synagogue next door = GABA-B (metabotropic, Baclofen prays there)

ASPARAGUS_VIP_DOOR.setting: Heavy iron door labeled 'NMDA'. Outside: chalk-white Ca²⁺ guests with '2+' badges wait in line. The lock has a horseshoe MAGNET (Mg²⁺) wedged in it. Above the door: a neon sign that flickers when depolarized.
recurring_elements: Mr. Asparagus (Mexican, methyl-mustache CH₃) = NMDA agonist itself (N-methyl-D-Aspartate)
G-shaped gray pebble at his feet = Glycine co-agonist
Horseshoe magnet in lock = Mg²⁺ block
Chalk-white guests with '2+' badges in line = Ca²⁺ entering
Neon sign flickering = depolarization (releases the magnet plug)

DAIRY_FARM.scene_name: Dairy Farm — opioid receptors and their animal residents
DAIRY_FARM.setting: A green farm on a hill. Each animal produces a different opioid-receptor effect. Hay bales, milk pails, and a Delta-Airlines plane droning overhead.
recurring_elements: Mooing cow ('MOO') = μ-opioid receptor
Grumpy goat with 'K' tag, kicking = κ-opioid receptor (dysphoria)
Delta-Airlines plane (triangular logo) overhead = δ-opioid receptor (less clinical)
Peaceful endogenous farmer = endorphins
Pails labeled: Analgesia / Euphoria / Constipation / Resp. Depression / Miosis = the spectrum of μ-effects

WONDERLAND_TEAPARTY.scene_name: Alice in Wonderland — Mad Hatter's tea party (Muscarinic receptors)
WONDERLAND_TEAPARTY.setting: Iconic Wonderland tea party. Each character maps to one muscarinic receptor by NUMBER + FUNCTION. The whole tableau goes haywire under anticholinergic blockade.
recurring_elements: White Rabbit with '1 O'Clock' pocket watch = M1 (CNS, memory of time)
Queen of Hearts holding TWO '2-of-Hearts' cards = M2 (heart)
Mad Hatter with 3 dripping teacups (saliva/tears/sweat) = M3 (glands)
Tweedledee & Tweedledum at the corners = M4 / M5 (less clinical)
Anticholinergic toxicity = whole scene gone wild: Mad Hatter mad, Red Queen flushed, March Hare hot, teacups bone-dry, Cheshire Cat invisible (pupils dilated)

CIGARETTE_THEATER.scene_name: Cigarette Theater — Nicotinic receptors on a smoky stage
CIGARETTE_THEATER.setting: Dim theater with cigarettes as branded characters on stage. Smoke curls. A wooden match (Acetylcholine = אצית) ignites scenes.
recurring_elements: Cigarette brand '42' = nAChR α4β2 (Hitchhiker's Guide answer — 4+2)
Old wise grandpa with 'Lucky 7' cigarette = nAChR α7 (cognition + schizophrenia hypothesis)
Backstage stagehand cigarettes = NMJ-type (α1β1γδ)
Wooden match (אצית) struck = Acetylcholine the agonist
Half-smoked cigarette in a smoker's hand = Varenicline partial agonism

H_HOUSE.scene_name: Histamine House — H-shaped building, 4 floors for H1-H4
H_HOUSE.setting: A literal H-shaped house. Each floor is a different histamine receptor subtype.
recurring_elements: Floor 1 (Living Room) — snoozing couch resident = H1 (sedation/allergy/weight)
Floor 2 (Kitchen) — leaking 'H2O' pots of stomach acid = H2 (gastric)
Floor 3 (Study) — autoreceptor professor dozing on his own desk = H3 (CNS auto, cognition)
Floor 4 (Rooftop) — immune-cell pigeons circling = H4 (immune)

ER_GUARD_POST.setting: Doorway labeled 'ER'. A sentry guard with 'S-1' badge stands at attention, escorting misfolded proteins.
recurring_elements: Guard with 'S-1' badge = sigma-1 chaperone protein
Misfolded proteins arriving in stress = clients of the chaperone
Fluvoxamine + Dextromethorphan visits = drug agonists at σ1

Mg2+.mnemonic_link: Mg = Magnet (both start with M). Magnetic block of NMDA = literal magnet on the door.

Ca2+.symbol: Chalk-white VIP guest with '2+' lapel pin
Ca2+.mnemonic_link: Ca = Calcium = chalk (calcareous). 2+ = the divalent charge as a name-badge.

Cl-.mnemonic_link: Cl = Chlorine (green gas in WWI). Minus shield = the negative charge.

Na+.symbol: Soldier wearing white SALT crystals with '+' epaulets
Na+.mnemonic_link: Na = Sodium = salt. + epaulets = positive charge.

K+.mnemonic_link: K = Potassium = banana (high-potassium food). + = positive charge.

D1_receptor.symbol: Single elevator with '1↑' button going UP to PFC top floor
D1_receptor.mnemonic_link: UP arrow = Gs/excitatory. '1' = D1. Top floor = PFC (working memory).
D1_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism = elevator rises bright; antagonism = stuck at ground.

D5_receptor.symbol: Glass elevator '5' ascending through 5 hippocampal library floors
D5_receptor.mnemonic_link: Same UP/Gs visual as D1. '5' = D5. Library = hippocampus/memory.

D2_receptor.symbol: Massive RED BARRIER labeled '2' across mesolimbic track with a foreman at lever
D2_receptor.mnemonic_link: DOWN = Gi/inhibitory. '2' = D2. Mesolimbic = psychosis track.
D2_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism = foreman LOWERS barrier (carts pile up; EPS pyramid-hatted workers spawn; prolactin pump leaks). Partial agonism = barrier hovers halfway (Aripiprazole/Brexpiprazole/Cariprazine). Agonism = barrier raised wide → runaway carts = stimulant psychosis.

D3_receptor.symbol: Three small red barriers in a heart-shaped (limbic) sub-chamber
D3_receptor.mnemonic_link: Red-barrier base = Gi. '3' barriers. Heart shape = limbic.
D3_receptor.function_depiction: Cariprazine operates ONLY these three (selective partial agonist).

D4_receptor.category: Dopamine D2-family (Gi) — high clozapine affinity, low EPS
D4_receptor.symbol: Four-bolt locking mechanism on a SILENT chamber door
D4_receptor.mnemonic_link: Same red-locked base (Gi). 4 bolts = D4. Silence = low EPS.
D4_receptor.function_depiction: Clozapine carries a Z-shaped master key that fits all 4 bolts.

5-HT1A_receptor.symbol: Bus-stop '1A' with anxious rabbit on bench
5-HT1A_receptor.mnemonic_link: Bus line 1A. Rabbit = anxiety. Bus arriving = anxiolysis.
5-HT1A_receptor.function_depiction: Partial agonists (Buspirone, Vilazodone, Vortioxetine, Aripiprazole) = different buses on the SAME 1A line. Empty bus for 4-6 weeks = SSRI delay-of-onset (autoreceptor desensitization).

5-HT2A_receptor.category: Serotonin (Gq, cortical) — psychedelic + atypical antipsychotic target
5-HT2A_receptor.symbol: Tarot table with 2 Ace cards, tie-dye hippie reader, swirling psychedelic walls
5-HT2A_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism (LSD/Psilocybin/DMT) = walls swirl wildly. Antagonism (all atypicals, Mirtazapine, Trazodone) = officer with flashlight turns lights off. Inverse agonism (Pimavanserin) = officer flips cards face-down.

5-HT2C_receptor.symbol: Kitchen with TWO chefs guarding cookie jar
5-HT2C_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Mirtazapine, Olanzapine, Quetiapine) = chefs KO'd, cookies stolen → weight gain.

5-HT3_receptor.category: Serotonin — LIGAND-GATED ION CHANNEL (unique!). CTZ + gut.
5-HT3_receptor.symbol: Three iron CHANNELS gushing green vomit-water
5-HT3_receptor.mnemonic_link: 3 = three gates. Iron channels emphasize ionotropic uniqueness.
5-HT3_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Ondansetron, Mirtazapine, Vortioxetine) = three identical PLUGS seal the gates.

5-HT6_receptor.symbol: Library with 6 framed PhD diplomas; old professor reads

5-HT7_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Lurasidone) = clerk turns off neon, locks doors (restored sleep).

SERT.symbol: Postal carrier in 'SERT' uniform collecting serotonin packages
SERT.function_depiction: SSRI = a 'NO PICKUPS TODAY' sign blocks the carrier. Packages pile up in synapse (more serotonin available). 4-6 week delay.

alpha1_receptor.symbol: Single LONE ALPHA WOLF charging at full hunt
alpha1_receptor.mnemonic_link: α1 = ONE wolf = true alpha. Hunt = post-synaptic action (vasoconstriction, alertness).
alpha1_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Prazosin, antipsychotic α1 block) = tranquilizer dart → wolf sits down → orthostasis. Prazosin specifically tames the wolf's nightmares (PTSD use).

alpha2_receptor.symbol: Two wolves; the one tagged '#2' pretends to be alpha but radios pack 'come back to base'
alpha2_receptor.mnemonic_link: α2 = TWO wolves. The #2 wolf isn't truly alpha → autoreceptor function (negative feedback).
alpha2_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism (Clonidine, Guanfacine) = friendly handlers feed the #2 wolf → whole pack calms (lowers central NE). ADHD = overactive pack settles.

beta1_receptor.symbol: Beethoven holding baton '#1' conducting heart-shaped drum section
beta1_receptor.mnemonic_link: BETHoven = β. Symphony #1 = β1. Drums = heart pounding.
beta1_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Propranolol, Metoprolol-class) = 'Quiet' sign mutes the drum section.

beta2_receptor.symbol: Beethoven holding baton '#2' conducting brass/wind section
beta2_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism (Albuterol) = winds blast open. Non-selective β-block (e.g. Propranolol) silences the winds → bronchospasm risk.

NET.symbol: Fishing NET hanging by the stage door — Beethoven catches stray notes (NE) with it
NET.mnemonic_link: NET acronym = literal net. Catching notes = re-uptake.
NET.function_depiction: Atomoxetine = small atomic ox tearing holes in the net. Bupropion = bumper-cars also tears net (NDRI). TCAs/SNRIs (Venlafaxine, Duloxetine) = various NET-blockers.

GABA_neurotransmitter.symbol: Aa Hotel manager holding the master key
GABA_neurotransmitter.mnemonic_link: GABA = manager who opens the Cl⁻ doors.
GABA_neurotransmitter.function_depiction: Opens the receptor channel → green chlorine soldiers (Cl⁻) rush in → hyperpolarization (inhibition).

GABA_A_receptor.category: GABA-A — ionotropic Cl⁻ channel. Pentameric: usually 2α + 2β + 1γ.
GABA_A_receptor.symbol: The hotel itself — 5-floor building with α-floor-specific functions
GABA_A_receptor.function_depiction: BZD = a partygoer that tickles the manager → doors open MORE FREQUENTLY (↑frequency). Barbiturate (Phenobarbital, barbed-wire fence) = lock-picker holding doors open LONGER (↑duration; high dose can open without GABA → lethal). Alcohol = also bribes the manager. Flumazenil (FLU character with tissues) = security guard who throws BZDs out.

GABA_A_alpha1_subunit.symbol: Floor 1 — Sleep Lobby with giant bed
GABA_A_alpha1_subunit.mnemonic_link: Floor 1 = ground floor = where you crash on arrival.
GABA_A_alpha1_subunit.function_depiction: Z-drugs (Zolpidem, Eszopiclone) = express elevators that ONLY go to Floor 1.

GABA_A_alpha2_alpha3_subunits.mnemonic_link: Middle floors = where you spend the calm part of your stay = anxiolysis.
GABA_A_alpha2_alpha3_subunits.function_depiction: BZDs broadly target these floors (Diazepam, Alprazolam, Lorazepam — anxiolytic action).

GABA_A_alpha5_subunit.symbol: Floor 5 — Memory Penthouse with a vault
GABA_A_alpha5_subunit.function_depiction: Knockout of α5 (e.g. Midazolam pre-surgical) = vault is robbed → amnesia.

GABA_B_receptor.category: GABA-B — metabotropic (Gi → K⁺ channel opens). NOT a chloride channel!
GABA_B_receptor.symbol: Small synagogue 'Bayit B' next door to the hotel
GABA_B_receptor.mnemonic_link: GABA-B = 'Bayit B' (House B in Hebrew). Separate building emphasizes that GABA-B is structurally different (G-protein, not ion channel).
GABA_B_receptor.function_depiction: Baclofen prays here (spasticity treatment). GHB visits (illicit/narcolepsy).

NMDA_receptor.category: Glutamate receptor — ligand-gated + voltage-gated (Mg²⁺ block). Ca²⁺ influx.
NMDA_receptor.symbol: Heavy iron door labeled 'NMDA' with horseshoe magnet wedged in lock
NMDA_receptor.mnemonic_link: Door = channel. Mr. Asparagus (NMDA = N-methyl-D-Aspartate) is the agonist. Magnet = Mg²⁺ block. Glycine pebble at his feet = required co-agonist. Chalk-white '2+' guests = Ca²⁺ entry.
NMDA_receptor.function_depiction: Three conditions for opening: 1) Asparagus present (glutamate/NMDA), 2) Glycine pebble present, 3) Neon sign flickers (depolarization) → magnet falls out. NMDA hypothesis of schizophrenia = rusty magnet, door never opens properly → negative symptoms.

Acetylcholine.category: Neurotransmitter — agonist for BOTH muscarinic AND nicotinic receptors
Acetylcholine.function_depiction: In Wonderland: the match lights the Mad Hatter's pipe (muscarinic activation). In Cigarette Theater: the same match lights the '42' and 'Lucky 7' cigarettes (nicotinic activation). One match = one ACh = two scenes (both receptor families share the same ligand).

mu_opioid_receptor.category: Opioid receptor μ — Gi (analgesia + euphoria + respiratory depression)
mu_opioid_receptor.symbol: Cow saying 'MOO', producing pails labeled Analgesia, Euphoria, Constipation, Resp. Depression, Miosis
mu_opioid_receptor.mnemonic_link: μ ≈ 'moo' — the sound a cow makes.
mu_opioid_receptor.function_depiction: Full agonism (Morphine, Fentanyl, Heroin, Oxycodone, Codeine) = milkers extracting effect. Partial agonism (Buprenorphine) = ceiling-effect milker. Antagonism (Naloxone, Naltrexone) = chase milkers off → withdrawal.

kappa_opioid_receptor.category: Opioid receptor κ — Gi (dysphoria, sedation, diuresis)
kappa_opioid_receptor.mnemonic_link: κ = Kappa = K tag. Goats kick (dysphoria).
kappa_opioid_receptor.function_depiction: Endogenous agonist = Dynorphin (sad farmer's tears). κ-ANTAGONISM is an emerging antidepressant target (Buprenorphine has κ-antagonist activity → mood lift).

delta_opioid_receptor.category: Opioid receptor δ — Gi (less clinical, mood modulation in research)
delta_opioid_receptor.function_depiction: Endogenous agonist = Enkephalins. No clinically used δ-selective drugs (research stage).

M1_receptor.symbol: White Rabbit clutching his '1 O'Clock' pocket watch, frantic about being late
M1_receptor.mnemonic_link: Pocket watch reads '1' = M1. Obsession with time = memory.
M1_receptor.function_depiction: Block (Atropine, Scopolamine, Benztropine, Diphenhydramine, TCAs at high doses) = Mad-as-a-Hatter delirium = the rabbit drops his watch and becomes the Mad Hatter.

M2_receptor.category: Muscarinic M2 — Gi, HEART (slows it via parasympathetic input)
M2_receptor.symbol: Queen of Hearts holding TWO '2 of Hearts' playing cards above her chest
M2_receptor.function_depiction: Block (Atropine) = Queen dizzy → tachycardia (loss of parasympathetic brake). Used clinically for symptomatic bradycardia.

M3_receptor.category: Muscarinic M3 — Gq, GLANDS + smooth muscle (secretions, GI, bladder, ciliary)
M3_receptor.symbol: Mad Hatter's tea table with 3 teacups overflowing — labeled saliva, tears, sweat
M3_receptor.function_depiction: Block = Dry as a Bone (no saliva/tears), Hot as a Hare (no sweat), Blind as a Bat (pupils dilated — iris constrictor is M3), urinary retention, ↓GI motility.

M4_receptor.category: Muscarinic M4 — Gi, CNS striatum (modulates dopamine release)
M4_receptor.symbol: Tweedledee at the corner of the party (less prominent)
M4_receptor.mnemonic_link: One of the lookalike twins (with M5) — pair for less-clinical receptors.
M4_receptor.function_depiction: Emerging antipsychotic target. Xanomeline (in KarXT, FDA-approved 2024) is an M1+M4 agonist — novel non-D2 antipsychotic.

M5_receptor.category: Muscarinic M5 — Gq, CNS reward circuits (VTA)
M5_receptor.symbol: Tweedledum at the corner of the party
M5_receptor.function_depiction: Theoretical role in addiction reward. No clinical drugs target M5 selectively yet.

anticholinergic_toxidrome.category: Anticholinergic syndrome — muscarinic blockade clinical presentation
anticholinergic_toxidrome.symbol: The whole Wonderland scene running riot — Mad Hatter completely mad, Red Queen flushed and screaming, March Hare panting hot, teacups bone-dry, Cheshire Cat invisible (just dilated pupils glowing)
anticholinergic_toxidrome.mnemonic_link: Each toxic sign = one Wonderland character. Memorable 5-character constellation.
anticholinergic_toxidrome.function_depiction: MAD as a HATTER (M1 CNS delirium), RED as a BEET (vasodilation), HOT as a HARE (M3 anhidrosis), DRY as a BONE (M3 hypo-secretion), BLIND as a BAT (M3 mydriasis + cycloplegia). Plus urinary retention + tachycardia (M2). Treatment: physostigmine (cholinesterase inhibitor) + supportive.

nAChR_alpha4_beta2.category: Nicotinic ACh receptor α4β2 — ligand-gated Na⁺/Ca²⁺ channel. Brain reward.
nAChR_alpha4_beta2.symbol: Branded cigarette labeled '42' (the answer to life, universe and everything)
nAChR_alpha4_beta2.function_depiction: Agonism (Nicotine) = full activation → dopamine in VTA → reward. Partial agonism (Varenicline) = half-cigarette → enough to satisfy craving but blocks full nicotine reward → smoking cessation.

nAChR_alpha7.category: Nicotinic ACh receptor α7 — Ca²⁺-permeable, cognition + schizophrenia hypothesis
nAChR_alpha7.symbol: Old wise grandpa smoking a 'Lucky 7' cigarette
nAChR_alpha7.function_depiction: Hypofunction in schizophrenia (sensory gating deficit, low CHRNA7 expression). Explains ~80% smoking rate in schizophrenia (self-medication of α7). Drugs targeting α7 are in development for cognitive symptoms.

H1_receptor.category: Histamine H1 — Gq (sedation, allergy, weight gain)
H1_receptor.symbol: Floor 1 living room — snoozing resident on a giant couch, allergy tissues nearby
H1_receptor.mnemonic_link: Floor 1 = ground level = where you collapse = sedation.
H1_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Diphenhydramine, Hydroxyzine, Mirtazapine, Quetiapine, Olanzapine, Doxepin low-dose) = sleep mask → sedation + weight gain. Many antipsychotics + atypical antidepressants block H1 = the primary cause of their sedation.

H2_receptor.category: Histamine H2 — Gs (gastric parietal cells → stomach acid)
H2_receptor.symbol: Floor 2 kitchen with pots labeled 'H2O' leaking stomach acid
H2_receptor.mnemonic_link: H2O = water = liquid stomach acid. '2' = H2.
H2_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Famotidine, Ranitidine, Cimetidine) = lids on the pots → antacid effect. Cimetidine notable: CYP inhibitor, anti-androgen → gynecomastia.

H3_receptor.category: Histamine H3 — Gi (CNS autoreceptor for histamine; also modulates other NTs)
H3_receptor.symbol: Floor 3 study — autoreceptor professor dozing at his desk (he's controlling his own histamine release)
H3_receptor.mnemonic_link: H + 3 = study floor. Auto-receptor = self-feedback (professor controlling himself).
H3_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism = professor sleeps deeper → drowsy patient. Inverse agonism (Pitolisant — alarm clock) = wakes him → ↑histamine release → wakefulness. Pitolisant approved for narcolepsy + EDS.

H4_receptor.category: Histamine H4 — Gi (immune cells; minimal psychiatric relevance)
H4_receptor.symbol: Floor 4 rooftop with immune-cell pigeons circling
H4_receptor.mnemonic_link: H + 4 = highest floor. Pigeons = immune cells.
H4_receptor.function_depiction: Inflammation modulation. Not a psychiatric target.

DAT.category: Dopamine transporter — reuptakes synaptic DA into the presynaptic terminal
DAT.symbol: A Jewish religious man (rabbi with payot and kippah) gathering scattered dopamine ore back home
DAT.mnemonic_link: DAT = דת (Hebrew: 'religion'). 'Religious man' = איש דת. Collecting ore back home = reuptake.
DAT.function_depiction: Inhibition (Methylphenidate, Amphetamine, Cocaine, Bupropion) = blindfold on the rabbi → can't see scattered ore → dopamine pools in synapse → enhanced postsynaptic effect.

VMAT2.category: Vesicular monoamine transporter 2 — packages monoamines (DA, NE, 5-HT) into vesicles
VMAT2.symbol: Yoga mat labeled 'V-MAT 2' — monoamines rest on it before vesicular release
VMAT2.function_depiction: Inhibition (Valbenazine, Deutetrabenazine, Tetrabenazine) = mat is stolen → monoamines never packaged → presynaptic depletion. Treats Tardive Dyskinesia + Huntington's chorea.

sigma1_receptor.category: Sigma-1 — chaperone protein at the ER (mood, neuroprotection)
sigma1_receptor.symbol: Sentry guard with 'S-1' badge at the door of the endoplasmic reticulum
sigma1_receptor.mnemonic_link: 'S' = sigma + '1' = subtype. Guard = chaperone (escorts misfolded proteins).
sigma1_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism (Fluvoxamine — uniquely strong among SSRIs; Dextromethorphan; some antidepressants) = guard escorts more clients → mood lift + anti-OCD/anxiety. Explains Fluvoxamine's particular efficacy in OCD beyond SERT block.

Lithium.symbol: Giant Li-ion battery labeled 'Li' with charge indicator
Lithium.mnemonic_link: Li = chemical symbol on the battery.
Lithium.function_depiction: Narrow voltage band on the indicator = narrow therapeutic window (0.6–1.2 mEq/L). Overcharged battery EXPLODES = toxicity at >1.5 (tremor → ataxia → seizures → death). Rechargeable = mood stabilization between mania and depression.

Valproate.symbol: Bald PRO athlete in a valley, holding a giant cake (weight gain) and stroking his bald head
Valproate.mnemonic_link: VAL-PRO = Valley + Pro. Bald + cake = hair loss + weight gain.
Valproate.function_depiction: Broad mood stabilizer + anticonvulsant. Hepatotoxic warning = liver dangling. Teratogen = pregnant woman shooed away.

Lamotrigine.symbol: Lamb standing on a hair-trigger, with red rash on its wool
Lamotrigine.mnemonic_link: Lamb-O-Trij → 'Lamb-on-Trigger'. Red rash = SJS / TEN warning.
Lamotrigine.function_depiction: Slow titration = lamb slowly stepping onto trigger. Carbamazepine ↓ levels (induces metabolism). Valproate ↑ levels (inhibits) → must halve dose.

Carbamazepine.symbol: A bread maze that redraws itself overnight
Carbamazepine.function_depiction: CYP-induces own metabolism (auto-induction). HLA-B*1502 in Asians = SJS risk. SIADH (low sodium) = the maze fills with water.

Diazepam.symbol: Backpacker in a green valley by a slow stream (DIA)
Diazepam.mnemonic_link: Diaz → Day-az → Day in a calm valley.
Diazepam.function_depiction: Long t½ + active metabolites = pitches a tent (stays awhile). Used in alcohol withdrawal (taper agent).

Alprazolam.symbol: Short, fluffy alpaca with a 'high-potency' boxing glove
Alprazolam.mnemonic_link: ALP-acalpaca. Short fluffy = short t½, high potency.
Alprazolam.function_depiction: Panic attacks = alpaca punches the attack. Inter-dose rebound = alpaca tantrum mid-day. Avoid in adolescents = no kids around alpaca.

Lorazepam.symbol: Grandma by the fireplace telling ancient LORE
Lorazepam.function_depiction: Hepatic conjugation only (no oxidation) = grandma doesn't need her liver oven. Catatonia challenge = grandma jolts patient awake with a story. IV/IM/PO available.

Clonazepam.symbol: Two identical CLONES walking together with long canes
Clonazepam.function_depiction: Long t½ = canes = stable, far walking. Less rebound than Alprazolam.

Midazolam.symbol: King MIDAS with a stopwatch — anything he touches turns rapid
Midazolam.function_depiction: Rapid IM/IV/IN onset. Intranasal in pediatrics for seizures. Surgical sedation + amnesia (hits α5 vault on Floor 5).

Phenobarbital.symbol: Barbed-wire fence (BARB) encircling the Aa Hotel
Phenobarbital.function_depiction: Keeps the hotel doors open LONGER (↑duration). At high doses, the wire opens the hotel WITHOUT GABA → lethal.

Flumazenil.symbol: Security guard with the FLU — sneezing, throwing BZD partygoers out
Flumazenil.function_depiction: Competitive BZD antagonist. Can precipitate seizures in chronic BZD users.

Fluoxetine.symbol: Glowing fluorescent OX that walks for weeks without resting
Fluoxetine.mnemonic_link: FLUO-OX → fluorescent ox. Glow = long t½ (the ox is 'lit up' for weeks).
Fluoxetine.function_depiction: Long t½ = ox needs slow taper or no taper. Best-tolerated in pediatric depression.

Sertraline.symbol: Knight (SIR) riding on rails — straight, steady, dependable
Sertraline.function_depiction: Broad-spectrum SSRI. Decent first-line for PTSD.

Paroxetine.symbol: Ox jumping out of plane with a PARAchute
Paroxetine.function_depiction: Short t½ + strong anticholinergic = parachute may fail → severe discontinuation syndrome. Most sedating SSRI. Teratogen warning (cardiac defects).

Bupropion.symbol: Bumper-car arena — cars colliding with high energy
Bupropion.function_depiction: NDRI = energizing (no sedation, no sexual dysfunction). Smoking cessation. ↓Seizure threshold = sparks flying when bumpers crash too hard. Avoid in eating disorders.

Mirtazapine.symbol: Person sitting in front of a MIRROR holding a slice of cake under a PINE tree
Mirtazapine.mnemonic_link: Mir + tas + pine → Mirror + cake + pine. Mirror = self-reflection at night (sedation). Cake = appetite/weight gain (5-HT2C + H1 block).
Mirtazapine.function_depiction: Strong H1 sedation, 5-HT2C → weight gain, 5-HT3 → antiemetic. Used in elderly with poor appetite + insomnia + nausea.

Vortioxetine.symbol: Wise tortoise wearing glasses, slow but multi-tasking
Vortioxetine.function_depiction: Multimodal: SERT block + 5-HT1A agonist + 5-HT3/7 antagonist + 5-HT6 antagonist (procognitive). Tortoise = slow + smart.

Methylphenidate.symbol: Schoolchildren in a row, focused, with methyl-CH₃ caps and phenyl-ring glasses
Methylphenidate.mnemonic_link: Methyl + Phenyl + Date (line) → focused line of students.
Methylphenidate.function_depiction: DAT/NET inhibitor. Activates the entire DOPA-MINE (more dopamine release). Pulls down EPS pyramids when overdosed.

Amphetamine.symbol: Guitar AMPlifier turned to 11 on stage
Amphetamine.function_depiction: DAT/NET inhibitor + RELEASER (extra mechanism). Stronger than Methylphenidate. Higher dependence.

Atomoxetine.symbol: Tiny ATOMIC ox riding the fishing NET (tearing holes)
Atomoxetine.mnemonic_link: Atom + Ox = atomic ox. NET-specific (no DAT).
Atomoxetine.function_depiction: Pure NRI. No abuse potential. Slow onset (weeks). Suicidality warning.

Clonidine.symbol: Two identical CLONE handlers feeding the #2 wolf
Clonidine.mnemonic_link: Clone + identical handlers = matches α2 'two wolves' scene.
Clonidine.function_depiction: α2 agonist = lowers central NE. ADHD, tic disorders, opioid withdrawal, hypertension. Rebound hypertension if stopped abruptly.

Guanfacine.symbol: Stoic GUARD with a stone face standing over the wolf pack
Guanfacine.function_depiction: α2A-selective = more PFC-specific (less sedation than Clonidine). ADHD adjunct.

Propranolol.symbol: PROfessional musician on stage — calm hands, no tremor
Propranolol.function_depiction: Non-selective β-block = mutes both heart drums (β1) AND wind section (β2 → bronchospasm warning). Akathisia treatment. PTSD prevention (debated). Lipophilic = crosses BBB.

Prazosin.symbol: Soldier receiving PRAISE for a nightmare-free night watch
Prazosin.function_depiction: α1 antagonist. Tranquilizer dart to the alpha wolf #1 = it sits → orthostasis (first-dose). PTSD nightmare relief. BPH.

Haloperidol.symbol: Angel with a HALO holding a stiff DOLL (rigid as EPS)
Haloperidol.function_depiction: High-potency 1st-gen = aggressive D2 barrier slam → lots of EPS pyramids around. Acute agitation IM. LAI form available (Halo-decanoate).

Clozapine.symbol: Master Z-key opening D4's four-bolt lock
Clozapine.mnemonic_link: clo-Z-apine = Z key. D4 affinity is unique.
Clozapine.function_depiction: Treatment-resistant schizophrenia + reduces suicidality. Agranulocytosis = white blood cells dying → mandatory ANC monitoring. Seizures + myocarditis + drooling + weight gain + metabolic syndrome. The Z key opens many other locks too (broad receptor profile).

Aripiprazole.symbol: Pizza pie with one slice RIPPED OUT (only partial)
Aripiprazole.mnemonic_link: A-RIP-piprazole = a rip in pizza. Partial slice = partial agonist.
Aripiprazole.function_depiction: D2 partial agonist + 5-HT1A partial agonist + 5-HT2A antagonist. Less metabolic. Akathisia common. LAI available.

Cariprazine.symbol: Person CARRYING a 'Praise' trophy to the limbic heart
Cariprazine.mnemonic_link: Carry + Praise. Trophy goes to heart-shaped (limbic) chamber = D3 selectivity.
Cariprazine.function_depiction: D3 > D2 partial agonist. Schizophrenia + bipolar depression + mixed states. Akathisia.

Lurasidone.symbol: Fisherman with a LURE off the side of a boat — best taken WITH 350+ kcal meal
Lurasidone.mnemonic_link: Lure → fisherman. 'On the side' = food requirement.
Lurasidone.function_depiction: Bipolar depression + schizophrenia. Low metabolic burden. 5-HT7 antagonist (turning off 7-Eleven at night).

Quetiapine.symbol: QUIET pine tree under which everyone naps
Quetiapine.function_depiction: Most sedating 2nd-gen (H1 + α1 block). Off-label for insomnia (low dose). Weight gain. Metabolic. Bipolar depression.

Olanzapine.symbol: OLYMPIAN athlete sleeping under a pine, surrounded by OLIVES
Olanzapine.function_depiction: Maximum metabolic burden (weight gain, dyslipidemia, T2DM). Strong sedation. Acute agitation IM (avoid IM with BZDs = respiratory depression!). LAI = post-injection syndrome warning.

Ketamine.symbol: Veterinary HORSE-tranquilizer dart wedged into NMDA door
Ketamine.mnemonic_link: Ketamine is famous as 'horse tranquilizer' in vet medicine.
Ketamine.function_depiction: Open-channel NMDA antagonist. Rapid-acting antidepressant (hours), treatment-resistant MDD, acute suicidality. Dissociation, BP↑, K-hole. IV/IM/IN.

Esketamine.symbol: Same horse-dart, but labeled 'S' on the forehead
Esketamine.function_depiction: Intranasal, on-label for TRD. REMS program required.

Memantine.symbol: Old grandmother (Mama-tine) with a cane — only blocks the rudest guests
Memantine.function_depiction: Use-dependent low-affinity NMDA antagonist. Off-label pediatric: autism aggression, OCD.

Naloxone.symbol: A NAIL knocking out a bull (OX-Knock-Out-Zone)
Naloxone.mnemonic_link: Nal-Ox-One → Nail + Ox + KO. Knocks out opioid effect.
Naloxone.function_depiction: μ-opioid antagonist. Intranasal/IM/IV for overdose reversal. Short t½ — may need re-dosing. Precipitates withdrawal.

Methadone.symbol: Mafia DON in a controlled clinic dispensing milk to his cows
Methadone.function_depiction: Long-acting full μ-agonist. Once-daily OUD maintenance (clinic-controlled, federally regulated). QTc prolongation.

Buprenorphine.symbol: Car BUMPER that only partially crashes into the door
Buprenorphine.function_depiction: Partial μ-agonist + κ-antagonist. Ceiling effect on respiratory depression. OUD maintenance. Combined with naloxone (Suboxone) = oral safety.

Disulfiram.symbol: Sulfur-smelly RAM that follows you to the bar — you drink, you stink
Disulfiram.function_depiction: ALDH inhibitor. Drinking alcohol = acetaldehyde build-up = severe nausea, flushing, vomiting. CYP-2E1/3A4 inhibitor (DDI risk). Hepatotoxic.

Varenicline.symbol: Smoker holding a HALF-smoked cigarette — can't get the full hit
Varenicline.mnemonic_link: Half cigarette = partial agonist of α4β2. (No brand reference.)
Varenicline.function_depiction: α4β2 nAChR partial agonist. Enough activation to ease craving, BLOCKS full nicotine reward → smoking cessation. Inserts onto the '42' cigarette in CIGARETTE_THEATER.

Morphine.symbol: Greek statue with a face that MORPHS into serene calm — labeled 'FINE'
Morphine.function_depiction: Full μ-agonist gold standard. Analgesia + euphoria + respiratory depression + constipation + miosis. The original opioid milker at the DAIRY_FARM cow.

Fentanyl.symbol: Skyscraper PENTHOUSE on the top floor — extremely high-up view
Fentanyl.function_depiction: 100× more potent than morphine. Surgical anesthesia, chronic-pain patches. Illicit fentanyl drives the overdose epidemic — tiny dose lethal.

Oxycodone.symbol: Patient wearing an OXYGEN mask, beeper showing 'CODE-RED' (respiratory code)
Oxycodone.function_depiction: Semi-synthetic μ-agonist. Oral. High abuse potential. Part of the OxyContin abuse epidemic.

Codeine.function_depiction: Prodrug → activated to morphine by CYP2D6. Cough suppressant + mild analgesic. CYP2D6 ultra-rapid metabolizers (5-10% of population, higher in some ethnicities) → high morphine levels = pediatric deaths reported (FDA contraindicated <12y for cough).

Tramadol.symbol: TRAM pulling a small DOLL down the street
Tramadol.function_depiction: Weak μ-agonist + SNRI (serotonin syndrome risk when combined with SSRIs/MAOIs!). Lowers seizure threshold. Prodrug via CYP2D6 (like Codeine).

Heroin.symbol: Fake HERO costume with a syringe sticking out of the cape (HERO-IN)
Heroin.function_depiction: Diacetylmorphine — lipophilic, crosses BBB rapidly → intense euphoric rush. Illicit. Major source of overdose deaths.

Atropine.symbol: TROPICAL tourist in shorts, sun-hat, holding a piña colada (A-tropic vacation)
Atropine.mnemonic_link: A-tropine → tropic. Vacation = far from cholinergic norms.
Atropine.function_depiction: Non-selective muscarinic antagonist. Wonderland goes wild → antichol syndrome. Clinical uses: symptomatic bradycardia, organophosphate poisoning, pre-op secretion drying, mydriasis (ophthalmology).

Scopolamine.symbol: Pirate with a teleSCOPE scanning the horizon for ships
Scopolamine.function_depiction: Crosses BBB → motion sickness patch + amnesia (historical 'truth serum'). Anti-emetic for post-op nausea.

Benztropine.symbol: Patient with a BENT-over back and SPRAINED wrist (Bent-Sprain) — relieved when given anticholinergic
Benztropine.function_depiction: M1 + H1 antagonist. FIRST-LINE for acute dystonia (IM 1-2mg = the iconic emergency-psych intervention). Drug-induced parkinsonism. Long t½ — once-daily.

Trihexyphenidyl.symbol: Spinning idol made of a TRIangle + HEXagon + PHENyl ring
Trihexyphenidyl.function_depiction: Oral anticholinergic for drug-induced parkinsonism + dystonia. Less sedating than Benztropine.

Diphenhydramine.symbol: Multi-headed HYDRA biting both Wonderland (M1) AND the Histamine House Floor 1 (H1)
Diphenhydramine.function_depiction: OTC sleep aid + anti-allergy. IM 25-50mg for acute dystonia (alternative to Benztropine). Anticholinergic side effects in elderly → cognitive impairment.

Hydroxyzine.symbol: Sleepy guest in the H-House Floor 1 living room with a 'Zzz' bubble — no IV bag (not addictive)
Hydroxyzine.function_depiction: H1 antagonist anxiolytic. Pediatric anxiety, pre-op anxiety, pruritus. NON-ADDICTIVE alternative to BZDs (no GABA action).

Pitolisant.symbol: Alarm clock RINGING in Floor 3 study — wakes the H3 professor
Pitolisant.function_depiction: H3 inverse agonist. FDA-approved for narcolepsy + excessive daytime sleepiness. Non-stimulant alternative to modafinil.

Dextromethorphan.symbol: Old cough-syrup bottle labeled 'D' — sometimes drunk recreationally by teens
Dextromethorphan.function_depiction: NMDA antagonist + σ1 agonist + cough suppressant. Recreational dissociative ('robotripping') at high doses. With quinidine (CYP2D6 inhibitor → ↑DXM levels) used for pseudobulbar affect.

Valbenazine.symbol: Thief stealing the V-MAT yoga mat — once a day
Valbenazine.function_depiction: VMAT2 inhibitor. FDA-approved for tardive dyskinesia. Once-daily dosing.

Deutetrabenazine.symbol: Same V-MAT thief, but with DEUTERIUM-armor (doubled hydrogens = slower clearance)
Deutetrabenazine.function_depiction: Deuterated → longer t½ than tetrabenazine. BID. TD + Huntington's chorea + Tourette's. Better tolerated than original tetrabenazine.

Tetrabenazine.symbol: Old-school V-MAT thief — works, but his victims become depressed afterward
Tetrabenazine.function_depiction: Original VMAT2 inhibitor. Huntington's chorea. BLACK BOX: depression + suicidality. CYP2D6-dosed.

Fluvoxamine.symbol: Singer with a FLU-affected VOice at the S-1 guard post, intrusive OCD lyrics
Fluvoxamine.mnemonic_link: Flu + Vox + amine. Voice problems = OCD intrusive thoughts.
Fluvoxamine.function_depiction: SSRI + strong σ1 agonist (UNIQUE among SSRIs — explains OCD/anxiety efficacy). FIRST-LINE pediatric OCD. CYP1A2 inhibitor → ↑clozapine, theophylline, caffeine levels.
